name: Server Clock
description: A clock showing NTP-synced server time, identical for every player. Runs on the Multiplayer Server.

changelog.notes: The runtime modules it used to carry now live in one place per scene, at src/scripts/runtime/ — updating removes this folder's copy and points its scripts at the shared one, so two items can no longer disagree about the same module.
Updated for the split between a request a player sends and a broadcast the server sends.
Ships an AI guide (ai.md) the in-app assistant reads before it writes timing code — the time-sync API, how to express a shared deadline, and the params, describing this exact copy.
Display (3D text / 2D UI) and a position dropdown for the 2D display
Time sync hardened with send-and-retry against the Multiplayer Server
Optional 2D UI display rendered at the top of the player's view
Initial release: 3D text clock showing the NTP-synced server time
